# Water unit — teacher guide
Edition: 2026. Grade 5. Unit 3, lesson 2. Teacher resource.

## Model comparison
Use a 120 mL model with 30 mL colored water and a 180 mL model with 45 mL colored water. Students decide which has the greater colored fraction, draw a representation, and justify their conclusion. The intended reasoning is fraction equivalence. Time: 35 minutes.

## Teacher key
Both models contain one-quarter colored water. Equal fractions do not imply equal absolute quantities; 45 mL exceeds 30 mL.

## Language supports
Partners rehearse a comparison orally before writing; provide labels for numerator, denominator, and whole. Allow drawings and home-language notes.

## Publisher note
No independent effectiveness study or California standards crosswalk is supplied.
